question: What does the anonymous first-party NLC Wenjin detail record establish for Zhao Wanli's 1951 《永樂大典展覽的意義——一九五一年八月北京圖書舘舉辦》, and does it emit a concrete fulltext route without requiring guessed identifiers or login?
answer: The source-emitted Wenjin detail record is anonymously reachable and closes the complete article title, author 趙萬里, document type 期刊论文, journal/source label 文物, 1951 no.9, pp.221-233, 13 pages, Chinese language, K87 classification, keywords, and a Chinese abstract. It names two source databases: 国家哲学社会科学文献中心中文期刊论文 and 维普中文科技期刊数据库. The detail page directly emits a concrete NCPSsd CooperationUser URI that wraps an articleinfo target, while directLink is empty. Wenjin itself still marks the user as not logged in and states that online reading cannot be used before login. Therefore KF closes an article-level metadata and source-emitted external-route bridge, but not the direct 1951 page text. The current carrier-label tension remains: this record emits 文物, while the separate NLC scholarly review emits 文物参考资料 for the same year/issue/pages; no silent title normalization is authorized.
